config.name: dataVolume.deleteOnVmDestroy
config.description: A boolean value indicating whether deleting attached data volumes when destroying a vm. If false, the data volume will be detached and be retained in primary storage

config.name: instanceOffering.setNullWhenDeleting
config.description: whether update instance offering column of VM inventory to NULL when the instance offering is deleted

config.name: deletionPolicy
config.description: the behavior of deleting a vm, options are [Direct, Delay, Never]. Direct: delete the vm from database and directly delete its root volume; Delay: change the vm's state to Destroyed in database; after the period controlled by 'expungePeriod' passes, delete the vm from database and delete it's root volume; Never: delete the vm from database but never delete its root volume

config.name: expungePeriod
config.description: the period before a destroyed vm being deleted from database and before its root volume being deleted from primary storage, in seconds

config.name: expungeInterval
config.description: the interval the expunging vm task runs, in seconds

config.name: cleanTraffic
config.description: switch for clean spoofing traffic from vm

config.name: multivNic.support
config.description: A boolean value indicating whether support to create more than one nics with a L3 network in the a VM. If false, there only no more than one nic can be created for a VM with a L3 Netowrk

config.name: spiceStreamingMode
config.description: config vm streaming mode when use spice

config.name: videoType
config.description: video type for VM. "virtio" supply basic video type. "vga" supply more high resolution for VM. "qxl" supply high performance when use SPICE protocal. "cirrus" mark as deprecated, reserved for compatibility. Options:[vga, cirrus, qxl, virtio]

config.name: soundType
config.description: sound type for VM. "ich6" supply basic sound typen for VM. Options:[ich6, ich9, ac97]

config.name: numa
config.description: whether to use numa structure

config.name: vm.max.vcpu
config.description: vm's maximum vcpu number

config.name: bootMenu
config.description: whether to enable boot menu

config.name: bootMenuSplashTimeout
config.description: splash timeout of boot menu in milliseconds

config.name: kvmHiddenState
config.description: hide KVM hypervisor signature to guest

config.name: emulateHyperV
config.description: whether to emulate hyper-v

config.name: additionalQmp
config.description: add an additional qmp socket, disable may cause some features can not work

config.name: vmPortOff
config.description: Disable VMWare io port emulation

config.name: pciePortNums
config.description: PCIe-root-port numbers of VM. On x86-64/q35, it determine the hot-pluggable pci device numbers.

config.description: default quota for volume.data.num

config.description: Scenarios supported by resource binding

config.description: the execution strategy when a vm crashed

config.name: crash.rebootThreshold.times
config.description: vm crash threshold in the specified time duration

config.description: unknown gc interval, by seconds

config.description: set vm clock track guest or host

config.description: enable uefi secure boot

config.description: enable vm device address record

config.description: enable vm internal ip address overwrite db record

config.name: uniqueVmName
config.description: enable vm name unique

config.name: vm.metadata.enabled
config.description: enable vm metadata

config.name: vm.metadata.lastRefreshVersion
config.description: Last completed upgrade refresh version, prevents duplicate triggers across MNs. Internal use only

config.name: vm.metadata.flush.concurrency
config.description: Max concurrent metadata flush tasks per management node

config.name: vm.metadata.flush.pollInterval
config.description: Metadata dirty poller interval in seconds

config.name: vm.metadata.flush.batchSize
config.description: Max dirty rows claimed per poll cycle

config.name: vm.metadata.cleanup.gc.interval
config.description: Metadata cleanup GC retry interval in hours

config.name: vm.metadata.flush.maxRetry
config.description: Max flush retry count before marking VM metadata as stale

config.name: vm.metadata.flush.zombieClaimThreshold
config.description: Minutes before an uncompleted flush claim is considered zombie and released

config.name: vm.metadata.maintenance.contentDriftInterval
config.description: Content drift detection interval in seconds. Drift detection is a fallback safety net; the primary mechanism is dirty marking via interceptors.

config.name: vm.metadata.maintenance.staleRecoveryInterval
config.description: Stale VM metadata recovery interval in seconds

config.name: vm.metadata.maintenance.staleRecoveryMaxCycles
config.description: Max stale recovery cycles before entering permanent-stale state

config.name: vm.metadata.payload.rejectThreshold
config.description: Max allowed VM metadata payload size in bytes. VMs exceeding this are skipped.

config.name: vm.metadata.maintenance.orphanCheckInterval
config.description: Orphan dirty-row detector interval in seconds. Releases rows claimed by dead management nodes.

config.name: vm.metadata.maintenance.staleRecoveryBatchSize
config.description: Max stale VMs processed per recovery cycle

config.name: vm.metadata.maintenance.contentDriftBatchSize
config.description: Number of VMs checked per batch during content drift detection

config.name: vm.metadata.maintenance.contentDriftBatchSleepSec
config.description: Sleep time in seconds between content drift detection batches to limit DB pressure
